dlg_ap_text: The hotspot uses the new name and password from its next start.
dlg_bind_code_text: The printer rejected the access code. Check it on the printer under Settings, Network.
dlg_bind_ip_text: This device could not reach the printer at that address. Check the address, and that both are on the same network.
dlg_bind_ok_text: This device is talking to the printer. The Status page fills in as the printer reports.
dlg_bind_sn_text: The printer did not accept that serial number. Copy it from the printer's own settings screen.
dlg_bind_unknown_text: The printer did not answer in a way this device understands. Check the details and try again.
dlg_conn_ok_text: This device joined the Wi-Fi network. Next, bind your printer.
dlg_conn_pw_text: The network refused the password. Check it and connect again.
dlg_conn_reconnect_text: This device lost the network and is trying again.
dlg_error_text: This device refused the request. Nothing was changed.
dlg_factory_text: This device erases its settings and restarts. Connect to its hotspot to set it up again.
dlg_hostname_text: This device restarts to take the new name.
dlg_hotspot_ip_text: This device restarts to move to the new address.
dlg_ota_err_text: This device did not accept the image. The running firmware is unchanged.
dlg_ota_text: This device restarts into the new firmware. This page reloads when it is back.
dlg_ota_unknown_text: This device did not recognise the upload type. Nothing was changed.
dlg_scan_ip_text: The printer answered from the address already stored here. If it cannot be reached, check the network settings.
dlg_scan_newip_text: The printer moved. Its new address is now stored here.
dlg_scan_ok_text: Pick a printer from the list, then bind it.
dlg_scan_sn_text: No printer on the network reported that serial number.
status_logs_label: The last lines the device wrote to itself
ui_a_factory_reset_erases_the_wi_fi_c: A factory reset erases the Wi-Fi credentials, the printer binding and every light setting. It cannot be undone from here.
ui_a_name_is_easier_to_remember_than_: A name is easier to remember than an address and survives the router handing out a different one.
ui_address_refused: The device refused that. Check every box holds an address like 192.168.1.50.
ui_ams_no_reading: The printer is not reporting a humidity reading.
ui_ap_note_off: Off, so this device is only reachable over your Wi-Fi. Turning it on gives you a way back in if the network ever changes.
ui_ap_note_on: Always on, so you can always reach this device. Changing the name, the password or this switch drops you if you are connected through it.
ui_band_help: How wide each stripe of the pole is, in LEDs. Zero lets the device choose.
ui_bg_help: What the unlit part of the bar shows. The barber pole alternates between the primary and this.
ui_bind_note: This device talks to the printer directly over your own network; nothing goes through Bambu's cloud. Scan finds Bambu printers on the network and fills in the serial number; the LAN access code is on the printer under Settings, Network, LAN Only Mode, and it changes if LAN Only Mode is turned off and on again.
ui_copy_help: Each of these copies once, when you press it. Nothing follows afterwards: press again to copy again.
ui_each_row_of_the_image_becomes_one_: Each row of the image becomes one frame across the strip. Held in memory, so it is gone after a restart.
ui_effects_help: The effect each bar state shows. Progress, the animated progress and the barber pole all draw the print percentage, so they need a printer bound and a print running to show anything.
ui_error_flash_help: What the bar does when the printer reports an error.
ui_factory_text: A factory reset clears the Wi-Fi credentials, the printer binding, the language and every light setting. The device reboots and has to be set up again. It cannot be undone from here.
ui_feat_auto_rebind_sub: After three failures the device scans and rebinds if the serial turns up at a new address.
ui_feat_bar_flip: Bar mounted the other way round
ui_feat_bar_flip_sub: Draws the bar end for end, so a unit mounted upside down reads the right way. Each effect’s own direction still applies over it.
ui_feat_config_io_sub: Export and import everything stored except the three passwords.
ui_feat_diagnostics_sub: While the network or the printer is unreachable the bar blinks a code instead of what it would show.
ui_feat_effect_colours_sub: Lit and unlit, each for printing and for otherwise, instead of the bar state’s colour.
ui_feat_effect_params_sub: Its own brightness, speed and direction, over the sliders above.
ui_feat_effect_ramp_sub: The brightness sweeps from the effect’s own value to a second one and starts over.
ui_feat_error_flash_sub: A colour strobes over whatever the bar shows while the state is error.
ui_feat_fx_barber_sub: Two colours crawling through the fill, with a band width of their own.
ui_feat_fx_hue_ramp_sub: One colour shifting by hue as the print goes on.
ui_feat_fx_progress_anim_sub: The fill with a chase and a breathing tip.
ui_feat_fx_progress_sub: The bar fills with the print percentage.
ui_feat_fx_temp_sub: One colour between a cold end and a hot end, following a printer temperature.
ui_feat_hot_warning_sub: A colour pulses over whatever the bar shows once a watched temperature passes a threshold.
ui_feat_presets_sub: Save an effect with its colours, timing and direction under a name, and copy it into any state.
ui_feat_preview_sub: Pins the bar to a chosen state for up to ten minutes so it can be looked at. Nothing is stored.
ui_feat_restart_sub: A plain restart with every setting kept.
ui_feat_stage_effects_sub: Fifteen rows. A stage without one inherits its bar state’s effect.
ui_feat_state_brightness_sub: Idle, printing and error each get their own brightness in each mode, instead of one for the whole mode.
ui_feat_state_effects_sub: In H2D each bar state runs an effect in the state’s colour instead of a solid fill.
ui_feat_static_ip_sub: Set the address on your network by hand instead of letting the router hand one out.
ui_features_help: Everything here is off on a new device. Each switch turns on one addition and nothing else changes.
ui_fill_in_the_serial_number_access_c: Fill in the serial number, access code and IP address first.
ui_fixed_address_help: Pick an address your router will not hand to anything else. It takes effect the next time this device joins the network.
ui_hostname_help: Adding .local to this name reaches this device from anything on the network.
ui_hot_warning_help: A colour laid over the bar once the reading passes the threshold.
ui_hotspot_help: Connect to this from a phone or laptop when this device is not on your Wi-Fi, then open the address below.
ui_hotspot_password_too_short: A hotspot password needs at least 8 characters, or leave it empty for an open network.
ui_humidity_is_a_level: The printer reports humidity as a level from 1 to 5, not as a percentage, and publishes no mapping between the two.
ui_leave_this_alone_unless_it_clashes: Leave this alone unless it clashes with something on your network.
ui_lights_help: One colour per segment of the bar, as the device reports its segments. It is stored and reported back, and nothing draws it yet: what a segment maps to on the strip is not established. The effects above are what the bar shows.
ui_needs_feature: Turned off. Switch it on under Features.
ui_no_image_storage: This unit has no image partition, so there is nowhere on it to put a stage image.
ui_note_ap_ip_text: The address this device answers at when you are connected through its own hotspot. Change it only if it clashes with a range your own network already uses.
ui_note_device_name_text: This device has one name. It is what the network calls it and what the bar above shows, and adding .local to it opens this page from anything on the same network.
ui_note_hostname_text: The name this device answers to on the network. Add .local to it in a browser on any device on the same network. It takes about a minute to register after a restart, so straight after an update use the address instead.
ui_note_sta_ip_text: The address this device has on your network. Type it into a browser on any device on the same network. The router may hand out a different one after a restart; the host name stays the same.
ui_pairing_help: Both devices show the same six digits. Check that they match, then confirm on each.
ui_pctl_needs_dev_mode: The printer refused: it only takes this from a signed app unless Developer Mode (LAN mode) is on.
ui_pick_a_colour_for_the_strip_you_ca: Pick a colour for the strip. You can change all of this later, in much more detail, on the Lighting page.
ui_presets_full: Every slot is used. Delete one to save another.
ui_presets_help: A named copy of an effect. Save the state you are editing, then apply it to another state or to a print stage.
ui_ramp_help: Where the brightness ends as the effect runs its length. Off leaves it flat.
ui_renderer_help: A bar showing the wrong thing, a renderer that has stopped and a strip that is not wired up all look the same from across a room. These numbers tell them apart.
ui_restart_text: It drops off the network for a few seconds while it reboots. Nothing is erased.
ui_same_network_help: Put this device on the same network as the printer.
ui_save_hotspot_settings_text: The device applies the new hotspot details and then offers to restart. If you are connected through the hotspot, you will be dropped and will need to rejoin under the new name.
ui_scan_help: This device finds Bambu printers on the same network. Pick yours and it fills in the serial; the access code is on the printer's own screen.
ui_settings_could_not_be_saved_the_de: Settings could not be saved. The device will forget them on restart.
ui_settings_file_help: Every setting as one file, to keep or to copy onto another unit. No passwords and no access code are in it, so put those back by hand after restoring.
ui_settings_refused: The device refused that file. It takes the file this page downloads, whole.
ui_stage_bed_heating_sub: Bringing the bed up to temperature.
ui_stage_bed_leveling_sub: Measuring the bed so the first layer sits right.
ui_stage_calibrating_flow_sub: Checking how much filament actually comes out.
ui_stage_filament_check_location_sub: Finding where the filament sits before moving it.
ui_stage_filament_cut_sub: Cutting the filament for a change.
ui_stage_filament_pull_back_cur_sub: Drawing the old filament back out.
ui_stage_filament_purge_old_sub: Pushing the last of the old colour through.
ui_stage_homing_sub: Finding the ends of each axis.
ui_stage_images_help: A GIF for each stage of a print, played on the bar while that stage runs.
ui_stage_nozzle_cleaning_sub: Wiping the nozzle before it starts.
ui_stage_nozzle_heating_sub: Bringing the nozzle up to temperature.
ui_stage_printing_ok_sub: The job finished without a fault.
ui_stage_printing_sub: Laying down layers. This is most of a job.
ui_stage_standby_sub: Powered on with no job running.
ui_stage_xy_mesh_mode_sweep_sub: Sweeping the bed to map its shape.
ui_stages_help: An effect per stage of a print. A stage left inheriting shows whatever the printing state shows.
ui_stages_need_presets: Save a preset first. A stage is assigned by name.
ui_state_brightness_help: What this bar state runs at in the mode chosen above.
ui_temp_gradient_help: The reading the gradient follows, and the two ends it spans.
ui_the_name_shown_in_the_bar_above_an: The name shown in the bar above and on your network.
ui_the_page_you_are_looking_at: The page you are looking at
ui_the_printer_is_refusing_commands_t: The printer is refusing commands. Turn on Developer Mode, under LAN Only Mode, on the printer's own screen.
ui_these_write_to_the_printer_so_they: These write to the printer, so they need Developer Mode switched on under LAN Only Mode. Everything above only listens.
ui_try_it_help: Hold the bar at a chosen state for a while, so an effect can be looked at without waiting for a print. Nothing is stored.
ui_turn_off_the_hotspot_text: With the hotspot off this device can only be reached over your Wi-Fi. If you are connected through the hotspot now, you will be dropped.
ui_type_this_address_into_a_browser_o: Type this address into a browser on any device on the same network to open this page again.
ui_unbind_note: This device clears the stored binding and stops talking to the printer. You can bind it again from this page.
ui_upload_sent: Sent. Waiting for the device to check it
ui_vent_help: This device finds vents running our firmware on the same network. Pick yours, or type its address.
ui_vent_wrong_one: A different vent answered at that address
waiting_for_device: Waiting for the device. These controls are showing placeholders until it answers, so they are inactive for a moment.
